2026-10-23-90.title: The morning summary comes when your work starts
2026-10-23-90.body: The morning summary email now comes at the start of your work hours, on your work days. Before, it came at 7:30 AM for everyone. You set your work hours in Settings, Quiet hours.

2026-10-23-89.title: Mention everyone
2026-10-23-89.body: Write @everyone or @all in a group, a project chat or a to-do thread. Madar sends a notice and a push to every person there. It sends no email. In Arabic, write @الجميع. Madar also shows an Everyone row when you type @.

2026-10-23-88.title: Quiet hours
2026-10-23-88.body: Madar now sends no push and no email outside your work hours. The bell and the Inbox keep everything. When your quiet hours end, you get one push. Until you choose, your hours are Sunday to Thursday, 9 AM to 5 PM. Your office keeps notifications on inside those hours. To change your days and hours, open Settings, Quiet hours.
